description: Defines the AclEntry interface representing an access control list entry with methods for creation, permission checks, and JSON serialization, marked as deprecated and specific to API version 1.

classes.name: AclEntry
classes.description: Interface representing an access control list entry with methods for instantiation, permission checks, and JSON conversion, deprecated in API version 1.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AclEntry with specified authorization subject and permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions, specifically V_1.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization subject of the ACL entry.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the ACL entry contains a specific permission.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if the ACL entry contains all specified permissions.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions associated with this ACL entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL entry to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL entry to JSON with specified schema version and field selector.
